visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of the modern, glass-clad exterior of the LaLaport shopping mall in Nangang under a cloudy sky. A young man with glasses and a blue t-shirt walks toward the camera in front of the entrance, smiling broadly. (2) Inside a bright restaurant named '享。THAI', the man sits at a wooden table; a dish in front of him is briefly engulfed in a controlled cooking flame. He is then seen using chopsticks to lift a piece of golden-fried chicken and later a large pork rib. The setting is clean with warm, soft lighting and wooden paneling. (3) The scene shifts to the 'Pomme-no-ki' restaurant entrance, followed by the man holding a large yellow circular menu showing different omelette rice sizes. He eats a spoonful of beef omelette rice, looking delighted. Close-ups show the creamy texture of the egg and sauce. (4) Transition to 'Tim Ho Wan', marked by its green and white signage. The man pulls apart a crispy, golden pineapple bun to reveal the meat filling inside. He then uses chopsticks to dip a shrimp siu mai into sauce and takes a large bite. (5) In '柚子花花', a Hakka restaurant with modern decor, the man wraps a piece of braised pork belly into a white bun (gua bao) and eats it enthusiastically. Plated goose meat and a bowl of colorful tangyuan soup are also shown on the table. (6) The man returns to the mall's main hall, speaking directly to the camera with a wide smile. Various storefronts like 'Unagiya' are visible in the background under bright indoor lighting.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between the modern exterior of LaLaport mall, featuring sleek curved architecture and large screens, and several high-end indoor restaurant interiors. The restaurants feature various styles: '享。THAI' has warm wood and modern pendant lights; 'Pomme-no-ki' has a casual vibe with bright red displays; 'Tim Ho Wan' uses classic green lattice dividers; and '柚子花花' features a clean, white-toned contemporary Hakka aesthetic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young male voice introduces the mall with a high-energy, fast-paced speech rate. He sounds excited and authoritative. Background music is a bright, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 drum beat. A quick 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition into the first restaurant. (2) Narrator describes the Thai-fusion dishes with enthusiastic pitch inflections. Short 'pop' sound effects punctuate the appearance of text on screen. The music remains consistent and high-energy. (3) The tone shifts slightly more melodic as he discusses Japanese omelette rice. Sounds of a spoon clinking against a bowl are audible but faint. A 'ding' sound effect marks a specific recommendation. (4) For the dim sum segment, the narration speed increases slightly to list items. The BGM maintains its tempo. (5) As Hakka cuisine is introduced, the vocal quality remains clear and friendly. The audio is layered with the narrator's voice dominant over the upbeat BGM. (6) In the closing segment, a very distinct 'whoosh' sound signals the transition back to the mall exterior. The narrator delivers a clear call-to-action with a rising intonation at the end.
